log.title: Sworn in as President
log.body: Golden Fixture takes the oath of office. Review the budget and your departments: the nation is watching your first decisions.

log.title: Embassy opened in United States
log.body: A permanent mission now works in United States (₹15 crore a month). Relations improve and proposals are likelier to succeed.

log.title: Upgrading Primary care
log.body: ₹4,500 crore goes into the Health department's primary care. It gains a star in about a month.

log.title: Construction begins in the East
log.body: Work starts on 500 × primary school for ₹500 crore. They open in a few weeks.

log.title: Police recruited in the North
log.body: 5,000 officers join the force for ₹100 crore in training. Their pay comes out of the Home Affairs budget.

log.title: Intelligence service: strength 55
log.body: The intelligence service grows from 50 to 55 for ₹600 crore; its running costs rise with it.

log.title: Power project begins in the West
log.body: Work starts on 4 × solar park for ₹6,000 crore, adding 0.4 GW on average. It connects to the grid in a few weeks.

log.title: Proposal for a grand military parade
log.body: The service chiefs suggest a large parade to show the forces to the public and raise morale.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions
log.body: Intermediaries suggest that a quiet round of talks with the most hostile neighbour might lower the temperature.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border
log.body: Gold, arms and drugs are flowing across a porous stretch of the frontier, with local officials turning a blind eye.

log.title: Death in police custody
log.body: A man died in a police lock-up. Protests have begun and videos are circulating widely.

log.title: India is asked to host a world trade expo
log.body: The organisers of a major trade expo want India as host. Delegations from dozens of countries would visit, with the contracts and publicity that follow.

log.title: Opened in the East
log.body: 500 × primary school open to the public.

log.title: Connected to the grid in the West
log.body: 4 × solar park now generate 0.4 GW on average.

log.title: Primary care: 3 stars
log.body: The Health department's primary care is now rated 3 of 5.

log.title: Proposal for a grand military parade: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The parade is shelved and units keep to their training schedule.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You keep your distance. The opposition asks what you are afraid of.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Smuggling continues, and so does the bribery that enables it.

log.title: Death in police custody: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You defend the police. Protests grow.

log.title: India is asked to host a world trade expo: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Another country takes the expo.

log.title: Global slowdown
log.body: Major trading partners are slowing sharply. Export orders are drying up and factories are warning of short-time work.

log.title: Friction with Singapore
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Singapore. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Global slowdown: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You wait. Growth takes the full hit for half a year.

log.title: Whistleblower comes forward
log.body: A senior civil servant has gone public with documents about bribe-taking in a ministry and is asking for protection.

log.title: Explosives cache found
log.body: A tip-off led police to a hidden store of explosives and detonators before they could be used.

log.title: Friction with Algeria
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Algeria. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Trade dispute with Indonesia
log.body: Indonesia has raised duties on Indian goods, saying India’s own tariffs are unfair. Exporters want the government to act.

log.title: Whistleblower comes forward: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The allegations are dismissed. The leak becomes its own scandal.

log.title: South Africa proposes a non-aggression pact
log.body: South Africa proposes that neither country attacks the other for 5 years. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Trade dispute with Indonesia: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Exporters absorb the higher duties for months.

log.title: Disinformation campaign
log.body: A flood of fake videos and forwarded messages is stoking panic and distrust online.

log.title: Senior adviser resigns
log.body: A trusted adviser has resigned, citing differences over direction. Leaks about infighting follow.

log.title: United States proposes a trade contract
log.body: United States offers a 3-year services contract worth ₹1,38,100 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Shipping lanes disrupted
log.body: Blocked straits and rerouted vessels are lengthening delivery times and raising freight costs. Ports report fewer arrivals and customs receipts are falling.

log.title: Doctors advise rest
log.body: A routine check-up shows signs of overwork. Your physician urges you to slow down for a few days.

log.title: Tax evasion exposé
log.body: Investigative reporters reveal that large firms and wealthy families have been hiding income abroad. The Finance ministry is under fire.

log.title: Power shortage
log.body: Heat and low coal stocks have pushed electricity demand past supply. Cities face long power cuts.

log.title: Fishing boats detained in the south
log.body: Oruvani patrol boats have detained a group of Indian fishing crews in disputed waters. Families are appealing to the government.

log.title: Disinformation campaign: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The rumours spread and anger builds.

log.title: Intelligence foils a plot by Shadow Meridian
log.body: Agents uncovered Shadow Meridian preparing an attack in the Central. The cell was rolled up before it could act.

log.title: Doctors advise rest: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You push on and stumble through a long speech. Photographs circulate.

log.title: Tax evasion exposé: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. A quiet settlement recovers a little. Critics call it an amnesty.

log.title: Chance to address the nation
log.body: Broadcasters offer prime time for a national address. What will you talk about?

log.title: Power shortage: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Rolling blackouts hit homes and factories.

log.title: Anti-corruption bill
log.body: A cross-party group offers a bill to give the anti-corruption agency stronger powers and tougher penalties.

log.title: Youth town hall
log.body: Student groups invite you to a televised town hall on jobs, climate and the future.

log.title: Fishing boats detained in the south: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The case drags on and the families blame the government.

log.title: Goodwill from Egypt
log.body: Egypt praised India’s role in a regional forum. Relations warm a little.

log.title: Goodwill from Morocco
log.body: Morocco praised India’s role in a regional forum. Relations warm a little.

log.title: Chance to address the nation: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You decline and the slot goes to the opposition.

log.title: Anti-corruption bill: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You shelve the bill. Campaigners are disappointed.

log.title: Audit report finds leakage
log.body: The national audit office reports that a sizeable slice of scheme money never reached its targets.

log.title: Youth town hall: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The envoy does a competent job. Few notice.

log.title: Police reform demanded
log.body: After a controversial arrest, civil-rights groups demand sweeping police reform: body cameras, training and oversight.

log.title: Questions over a defence contract
log.body: A newspaper alleges inflated prices and favoured suppliers in a recent equipment contract. The opposition wants an inquiry.

log.title: Maritime incident
log.body: A fishing boat has been seized in disputed waters and the crew are being held. Coastal communities are demanding action.

log.title: Locust swarms over the West
log.body: Huge swarms of locusts are stripping fields across the West. Farmers are watching a season of work disappear.

log.title: Locust swarms over the West: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The central government stays out. Anger builds in the West.

log.title: River floods in the North-East
log.body: Rivers have burst their banks across the North-East. Villages are cut off and thousands have moved to relief camps.

log.title: Audit report finds leakage: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The report is tabled and forgotten.

log.title: Police reform demanded: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You reject the demand. The criticism gets louder.

log.title: Questions over a defence contract: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The ministry insists the contract was sound. The press keeps digging.

log.title: National honour for the nation
log.body: Athletes and scientists bring home medals and a landmark mission success. The country celebrates, and the mood rubs off on you.

log.title: River floods in the North-East: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The central government stays out. Anger builds in the North-East.

log.title: Maritime incident: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The crew stay detained for months. Families protest.

log.title: Opposition motion in Parliament
log.body: The opposition has tabled a no-confidence style motion in the House and wants a vote this month.

log.title: Security gap at major airports
log.body: A surprise audit shows that screening at several airports and rail hubs can be bypassed.

log.title: Ghost beneficiaries in welfare schemes
log.body: An audit finds millions of rupees paid out every month to people who do not exist.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border
log.body: Gold, arms and drugs are flowing across a porous stretch of the frontier, with local officials turning a blind eye.

log.title: Opposition motion in Parliament: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You win the vote, but the debate leaves you looking defensive.

log.title: Security gap at major airports: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The upgrade is added to a long list of plans.

log.title: Ghost beneficiaries in welfare schemes: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Nothing changes, and the money keeps leaking.

log.title: Germany proposes a trade contract
log.body: Germany offers a 3-year industry contract worth ₹1,44,700 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: South Africa proposes a non-aggression pact
log.body: South Africa proposes that neither country attacks the other for 5 years. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Goodwill from Nigeria
log.body: Nigeria praised India’s role in a regional forum. Relations warm a little.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Smuggling continues, and so does the bribery that enables it.

log.title: A supplier offers equipment at a discount
log.body: A friendly industrial power offers a batch of modern equipment on favourable terms, if you act this quarter.

log.title: South Korea proposes joint military exercises
log.body: Defence officials in South Korea have proposed a joint exercise to improve interoperability and signal partnership.

log.title: Annual report 2026
log.body: The government closed 2026 with a deficit of ₹8,18,858 crore. Growth 5.7%, inflation 4.0%, unemployment 7.9%, debt 53.0% of GDP. Approval stands at 33.3%.

log.title: Murmurs in the barracks
log.body: Senior officers are grumbling about pay, promotions and the government's direction. Some talk of "restoring order".

log.title: A supplier offers equipment at a discount: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The offer lapses. Domestic manufacturers are pleased.

log.title: South Korea proposes joint military exercises: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. India declines. The host is mildly disappointed.

log.title: Murmurs in the barracks: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You ignore the chatter. Resentment hardens.

log.title: Large arms haul seized
log.body: Police and customs have seized a huge cache of weapons and explosives bound for criminal networks.

log.title: Farmers march on the capital from the North-East
log.body: Farmers from the North-East have set out for the capital, demanding better support prices and debt relief.

log.title: Friction with Morocco
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Morocco. Relations cool a little.
